cases.prompt: Show me every SparkLaunch project I can access and help me choose one.
cases.rationale: Requests the connected projects.list workflow.

cases.prompt: Create a new SparkLaunch project for my robotics marketplace.
cases.rationale: Requests a persisted projects.create operation.

cases.prompt: Validate my startup idea in SparkLaunch and analyze the market, competitors, and market size.
cases.rationale: Requests the connected validation creation and analysis workflow.

cases.prompt: Retrieve the completed analysis for my SparkLaunch validation project.
cases.rationale: Requests a saved validation project read.

cases.prompt: Generate and save color palette options for my selected SparkLaunch project.
cases.rationale: Requests branding.generate_palette.

cases.prompt: List the color palettes already saved in my SparkLaunch project.
cases.rationale: Requests branding.list_palettes.

cases.prompt: Generate a private logo asset for my connected SparkLaunch project.
cases.rationale: Requests crm.generate_logo.

cases.prompt: Use my brand colors and business name to create a SparkLaunch logo file.
cases.rationale: Requests the connected logo generation workflow and file result.

cases.prompt: Create a SparkLaunch launch campaign, short link, and QR asset for my landing page.
cases.rationale: Requests campaign, short-link, and QR MCP operations.

cases.prompt: Check my SparkLaunch campaign statistics, then prepare to pause the campaign if I approve.
cases.rationale: Requests a campaign read followed by a confirmed public-state change.

cases.prompt: Create content for a SparkLaunch landing page and ask before publishing it.
cases.rationale: Requests private landing-page creation followed by confirmed publication.

cases.prompt: Show views, clicks, and lead submissions for my SparkLaunch landing page.
cases.rationale: Requests connected landing analytics and lead reads.

cases.prompt: Find Jordan in my SparkLaunch CRM and show the saved contact workspace.
cases.rationale: Requests private CRM search and workspace retrieval.

cases.prompt: Add this approved follow-up note to the selected lead in my SparkLaunch CRM.
cases.rationale: Requests a bounded CRM write.

cases.prompt: Use SparkLaunch to take my idea through project setup, validation, branding, and a measurable launch.
cases.rationale: Requests the broad connected founder workflow and routing skill.

cases.prompt: Help me choose the right SparkLaunch workflow for launching and following up with leads.
cases.rationale: Requests routing across multiple narrower SparkLaunch skills.

cases.prompt: Use SparkLaunch to incorporate my startup and guide me through the secure steps.
cases.rationale: Requests the connected entitlement, case, Action Center, and internal submission workflow.

cases.prompt: I do not have the SparkLaunch incorporation plan yet. Check what I need and help me recover access.
cases.rationale: Requests authoritative Incorporation Package entitlement state without exposing or facilitating a purchase through ChatGPT.

cases.prompt: Set up our SparkLaunch incorporation case for two founders and a separate responsible party who must verify their own identity.
cases.rationale: Requests shared ordinary draft preparation with private participant-specific Action Center tasks.

cases.prompt: Resume my existing SparkLaunch incorporation and tell me which people still have tasks before we can submit internally.
cases.rationale: Requests safe case readback, participant progress, and resumption guidance.

cases.prompt: My incorporation draft changed while I was editing it. Re-read the latest version and help me apply the requested correction safely.
cases.rationale: Requests stale-version recovery and a corrected successor incorporation draft.

cases.prompt: Invite Pat as a general collaborator on my SparkLaunch project; this is not for an incorporation case.
cases.rationale: General project collaboration remains a projects workflow and must not trigger incorporation.

cases.prompt: What are the usual stages of building a startup?
cases.rationale: Generic advice does not request a connected SparkLaunch operation.

cases.prompt: Explain complementary colors and visual contrast.
cases.rationale: Generic color advice should not persist a SparkLaunch palette.

cases.prompt: What makes a logo memorable?
cases.rationale: Generic logo advice does not request SparkLaunch logo generation.

cases.prompt: Write a standalone HTML page for a school project.
cases.rationale: Generic web development is outside SparkLaunch landing-page operations.

cases.prompt: Explain consultative selling techniques.
cases.rationale: Generic sales strategy does not request a SparkLaunch CRM operation.

cases.prompt: Compare popular URL shortening services.
cases.rationale: A comparison does not request creation of a SparkLaunch campaign or short link.

cases.prompt: Explain the difference between TAM, SAM, and SOM.
cases.rationale: An explanation does not request a saved SparkLaunch validation analysis.

cases.prompt: What is the weather forecast for Phoenix tomorrow?
cases.rationale: The request is unrelated to every SparkLaunch workflow.

cases.prompt: Review my SparkCap ownership and model a two-million-dollar priced raise.
cases.rationale: Requires connected cap-table readback and an unsaved raise model.

cases.prompt: Add an advisor with 20000 planning shares to my SparkLaunch cap table.
cases.rationale: Requires current version, usage, and confirmed stakeholder creation.

cases.prompt: Explain what a cap table is without accessing any account.
cases.rationale: Generic explanation requires no SparkLaunch operation.

cases.prompt: Prepare my SparkLaunch investor data room using the company library charter and financials.
cases.rationale: Requires room selection and confirmed pinned document additions.

cases.prompt: Create a seven-day view-only link to my SparkRoom and show its usage.
cases.rationale: Requires explicit sharing consent and private usage readback.

cases.prompt: Explain what investors usually expect in a diligence data room, without accessing any account.
cases.rationale: Generic education does not use SparkLaunch workspace data.

cases.prompt: Model a $500000 SAFE at a $10 million post-money cap in my SparkClose project and save the scenario.
cases.rationale: Requires canonical SAFE modeling and a confirmed saved snapshot.

cases.prompt: Review my signed SparkClose investment, record the company-confirmed receipt and help me close it.
cases.rationale: Requires reviewed evidence, distinct funding and closing gates, confirmation and destination readback.

cases.prompt: Explain whether a SAFE is a good investment for me without accessing any account.
cases.rationale: Generic investment education or advice does not use SparkLaunch workspace data or trigger SparkClose.

cases.prompt: Prepare an unsigned SAFE in SparkClose using the full agreement our company has reviewed. I will confirm the exact draft before you save it.
cases.rationale: Preview the exact reviewed content and source mappings, then confirm unsigned preparation without signing or sharing.

cases.prompt: I own a Growth project but SparkClose reports insufficient_scope when I try to save my SAFE model.
cases.rationale: A missing OAuth grant requires host reconnection and named permissions, not an inferred plan upgrade.
